notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update[/h1]

I've finally released a major update I've been working on for a long time, this update changes the game completely to be much more enjoyable.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

First off is the gameplay itself, there are a few new features but one of the main ones is now enemies actually fight back so the game is more challenging and engaging, enemy units will destroy your towers and actually pose more of a threat rather than just getting from A to B.

[h2]Graphics[/h2]

The graphics of the game has been improved massively, honestly before this update I wasn't really sure what hardware I was targeting but I've decided to up the quality a lot without pushing it too far so people with less powerful systems can enjoy it as well.

[h2]Levels[/h2]

In the original version, I basically had an unfinished start of a campaign which didn't really make sense, you basically had some short levels and that was it.

In this update instead, there are Endless levels so you can now play for as long as you can survive, and these will be the main focus on early access, I'll be making the campaign but it won't be released until it's done along with an actual storyline.

notes.title: Another small patch
notes.content:
Still using a laptop while I wait for my workstation to arrive in Canada from the UK

I've focused on camera movement in this to make things more enjoyable,

- Added WASD movement to the camera
- Added Sound volume control to the options in main menu
- Fixed camera collisions and movement speed
- Small level changes.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
It's been a while since any form of update or content has been added, just so everyone knows the game is developed by me alone and to explain the lack of update.

It's simply because I've moved to a new country and I'm still getting my life set up again here.

Soon however I should have everything sorted and be able to update more regularly.

Fixes
- Fixed a bug causing currently unused UI to appear
- Fixed Currently unfinished feature still being in the game

Changes
- Updated lighting in all levels
- Made performance improvement to all levels
- Made some small visual improvements to some levels
